content: अवनिः, -नी {%f.%} [अव्-अनि <ls>Uṇ. 2. 101</ls>] .²1 The earth; often used at the end of <ab>comp.</ab> meaning ‘ground’, ‘place’; काननावनौ <ls>Dk. 7</ls>, <ls n="Dk.">13</ls>; लीलावनौ place of recreation <ls n="Dk.">25</ls>. .²2 A finger (<ls>Nir.</ls>) .²3 A river; सं यं स्तुभोऽवनयो न यन्ति <ls>Rv. 1. 190</ls>. .²4 Course, bed of a river, अवनिंगत {%a.%} fallen prostrate on the gound.
अवनी €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To lead or bring down, to push into; अश्वानपोऽवनीयमानान् <ls>Kāty.</ls> .²2 To cause to descend or flow. .²3 To lead away. .²4 To pour down or over.
